summary.en: Database client with a Windows Arm64 (aarch64) installer in the 26.2.3 release.
summary.zh-TW: 資料庫用戶端，26.2.3 版提供 Windows Arm64（aarch64）安裝程式。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Listed from the winget manifest, which points to the vendor's GitHub release asset; the program was not run.
caveats.zh-TW: 依據 winget 資訊清單（指向原廠 GitHub 發行檔），未實際執行。
